cases.question: 用 CTE 统计每月订单数，并给出每月订单占全年比例（2017 年）。
cases.golden_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, cnt, ROUND(cnt * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM monthly), 2) AS pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month
cases.pred_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
      AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
    mo.month,
    mo.order_count,
    ROUND(mo.order_count * 100.0 / to.total_count, 2) || '%' AS percentage
FROM monthly_orders mo
CROSS JOIN total_orders to
ORDER BY mo.month
LIMIT 1000
